tuv.seg: 青花瓷是中国陶瓷史上最具代表性的品种之一。
Blue-and-white porcelain is one of the most representative wares in the history of Chinese ceramics.
景德镇自元代起成为全国的制瓷中心。
Jingdezhen became the national centre of porcelain production from the Yuan dynasty onwards.
窑工通过控制窑温与气氛来决定釉色。
Potters determined the glaze colour by controlling kiln temperature and atmosphere.
考古发掘为研究瓷器的生产流程提供了实物证据。
Archaeological excavations provide material evidence for studying porcelain production processes.
